# Sahaya Savari F

> AI Engineer · Python Developer · Full Stack Developer · M.Sc. Artificial Intelligence Student

Portfolio and professional website of Sahaya Savari F.

## Pages

- [Home](https://sahayasavari.dev/): Portfolio home page with hero overview, skill highlights, and contact information.
- [Projects](https://sahayasavari.dev/projects): Engineering portfolio showcasing AI/ML applications, full-stack systems, and open-source tools.
- [Resume](https://sahayasavari.dev/resume): Interactive resume viewer, education, career milestones, and verified skill credentials.
- [Blog](https://sahayasavari.dev/blog): Technical articles on autonomous AI agents, Python data engineering, React performance, and modern web architectures.
- [Recruiter Summary](https://sahayasavari.dev/recruiter): Concise summary for recruiters and hiring managers highlighting core competencies and availability.
- [AI & Machine Learning](https://sahayasavari.dev/ai): In-depth overview of Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning, and LLM engineering expertise.

## Featured Projects

- [PrepMind AI](https://sahayasavari.dev/projects/prepmind-ai): LLM-powered educational platform transforming study materials into adaptive quizzes and summaries.
- [Daily Spark](https://sahayasavari.dev/projects/daily-spark): Offline-first habit and streak tracking application built with React, TypeScript, and IndexedDB.
- [Portfolio Website](https://sahayasavari.dev/projects/portfolio-website): High-performance portfolio built with React 19, Vite 7, Tailwind CSS v4, and static HTML pre-rendering.
